title: [critical-path] Inject AGENT_VAULT_TOKEN + broker addr + vault into BC container env (controller.py)
description: GAP: controller.launch() injects ONLY HTTPS_PROXY=<broker_address> into the container env (controller.py:424). It does NOT inject AGENT_VAULT_TOKEN (av_agt_...), AGENT_VAULT_ADDR, or AGENT_VAULT_VAULT — grep of src/ finds zero references. The in-container 'agent-vault run' client therefore has no token/vault and cannot authenticate to the broker. Add env injection of the agent token + broker addr + vault, sourced from launcher env (and the CLI knobs in the sibling CLI bead). Critical path: without this a relaunched BC reaches the broker port but cannot authenticate.

title: [critical-path] Mount broker CA + set TLS trust env (NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS/SSL_CERT_FILE/GIT_SSL_CAINFO) in container (controller.py)
description: GAP: no broker CA is mounted and no trust env is set anywhere. The broker substitutes credentials by intercepting outbound HTTPS (HTTPS_PROXY -> TLS MITM); without the broker CA trusted inside the container, claude (node) and git HTTPS calls through the proxy FAIL cert verification. Bind-mount the broker CA and export NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS (claude/node) + SSL_CERT_FILE/REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE (python) + GIT_SSL_CAINFO (git). Critical path.
close_reason: Delivered via the CA-env redesign (commit f1b85a8, now on origin/main 67ba372): broker CA travels as AGENT_VAULT_CA_PEM env and the bc-base entrypoint materializes the CA + exports NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS/SSL_CERT_FILE/REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE/CURL_CA_BUNDLE/GIT_SSL_CAINFO. Reviewer CLEAN: trust vars confirmed reaching 'agent-vault run -- claude' via the tmux login-shell /etc/profile.d path. 156 tests passing. Original bind-mount approach superseded by env delivery.

title: [critical-path] Fix default agent-vault broker address to http://agent-vault:14321 (controller.py:71) or hard-require override

publish-bc-base.yml fails at 'Set package visibility to public' (gh PATCH /user/packages/.../visibility -> 404) on every release v0.2.0-v0.2.5
description: CI DEFECT (recurring, all 6 releases red): publish-bc-base.yml build-and-push step SUCCEEDS (image is built + pushed to ghcr.io/dstengle/shopsystem-bc-base; v0.2.5 manifest returns HTTP 200, pullable with auth), but the job's overall conclusion is FAILURE because step 5 'Set package visibility to public' runs 'gh api --method PUT/PATCH /user/packages/container/shopsystem-bc-base/visibility -f visibility=public' and gets 'gh: Not Found (HTTP 404)'. Root cause: /user/packages/ is the wrong endpoint for this package's ownership, OR the GITHUB_TOKEN/actor lacks packages admin scope. Consequence for the fleet flip: the GHCR package may remain private, so 'docker pull ghcr.io/dstengle/shopsystem-bc-base:v0.2.5' requires registry auth rather than being anonymously pullable. FIX OPTIONS: (a) correct the endpoint to /orgs/{org}/packages/container/{pkg}/visibility or /user/... matching actual ownership; (b) grant the workflow a token with packages:write admin; (c) set the package public once manually in GHCR settings (visibility is sticky) and drop the step; (d) make the step non-fatal (|| true) if public-ness is handled out of band. Verified against run 27297009114 (v0.2.5) job 80632290637 step 5. Relates lead-if8q, lead-79kp.

title: __probe__
Partial agent-vault triple + no explicit broker silently falls back to :14321 runtime HTTPS_PROXY instead of failing closed
description: Reviewer A3 finding on lead-3q12 (non-blocking, deferred by PO). _build_runtime_proxy_url (controller.py:261-307) derives the :14322 MITM proxy only when the FULL triple (AGENT_VAULT_ADDR/TOKEN/VAULT) is present and no explicit --agent-vault-broker is given. A PARTIAL triple (e.g. addr+token, vault missing) with no explicit broker returns None and falls back to bare broker_address (:14321 control API) at controller.py:640-645 — claude's brokered calls then fail at runtime (CONNECT 405) with NO launcher-side error. Matches pre-3q12 behavior (not a regression) and the HEALTHCHECK target, so left as-is for v0.2.6. Proposed tightening: launch should FAIL CLOSED naming the missing AGENT_VAULT_* key rather than ship a :14321 runtime proxy. PO (dave) to decide whether to pin. Relates lead-3q12, bclaunch-way.

title: Tighten profile.d trust-var scenario: pin runtime env inheritance across tmux login-shell boundary, not static Dockerfile string
description: Review of agent-vault CA-env redesign (commits f1b85a8/df51d8d/25ac332) found that features/bc_base_agent_vault_entrypoint.feature scenarios (step defs conftest.py:4567-4626) only assert on static file content via read_text()+regex. The scenario 'the trust vars are durable for exec and login shells via /etc/profile.d' (feature line 41) asserts a profile.d script string exists in the Dockerfile but does NOT pin the actual runtime inheritance across the tmux login-shell boundary (controller.py:649-728 tmux new-session -> login bash -> sources /etc/profile.d/agent-vault-ca.sh -> send-keys 'agent-vault run -- claude'). Implementation is correct today, but a future controller.py change (e.g. tmux default-command 'bash --noprofile' or a non-login launch) would silently break TLS trust while leaving all 156 tests green. Add a Then step that exercises env inheritance through a login-shell sourcing of /etc/profile.d, OR pins that the controller tmux launch remains a login shell. Same tautological-pinning class as bclaunch-7ys.

value: This BC environment has NO GitHub push auth by default: no gh binary (yet 'gh auth git-credential' is the configured credential helper, so plain 'git push' fails), no GITHUB_TOKEN/GH_TOKEN env var, no SSH key. To push you need an external credential — e.g. 'git -c credential.helper= push https://x-access-token:<PAT>@github.com/dstengle/shopsystem-bc-launcher.git HEAD:main'. The reviewer's pre-emit gate requires the work commit reachable on origin/main, so a missing push blocks sign-off until resolved.
